en: Sonja's quite clever.\fShe hid her units in some\rvery strategic locations.\fSo, emulate her tactics and use the\rwoods for cover when moving.\fYou should be able to avoid a lot\rof damage that way.\fBetter luck next time!\f
What? Really?\f
You seem to\rbe in good spirits, though.\fWell, whatever.\f
Oh, good. That's a relief.\fWe'd be lost if you got\rknocked out, too.\f

Oh, great. Fog of War...\fThis is Sonja's forte.\fWell, we have to cross the water\rhere, so we must protect our landers.\fWe'll have no chance of victory if\rwe can't transport our troops.\fLet's try and use the reefs for\rcover as we go.\fI think Sonja's forgotten that I'm an\rinfantry troop specialist, though.\fIf we need to capture properties to\rwin this, then it's as good as done!\fGet ready, Sonja!\rWe're comin' for you!\f
Nice to see you again, Sonja.\f
Grit!\fDid you discover anything?\f
Nope. Not a darn thing.\fI was able to follow\rHis Beardedness, but...\fI think Olaf himself has been\rtossed by the wayside.\f
Oh...\f

Maybe Olaf'll realize that he's\rbeen used. That'd be nice.\fHe ain't such a bad guy, you know?\fLet's move on to somethin' else\rnow, Sonja.\fDon't you think you're taking\rthings a tad bit too far?\fThere's a whole mess of folks after\ryou, darlin'. Like all of Orange Star.\f
Really?\fActually, I don't think I've\rdone enough.\fThis is invaluable intel that I'm\rgathering. I must continue!\f
Well, if you're that determined,\rI guess I ain't got nothin' else to say.\fI'll go see what else I can find out.\f
OK. Thanks, Grit!\f
My, oh, my!\fYou're much stronger than\ryou used to be, aren't you?\f
Of course I am!\f

But your basic abilities haven't\rreally changed at all, have they?\fIn an area with lots of properties\rto capture, your skills are adequate.\fBut you're still poor\rat indirect combat.\fIn straight-up battle, you'd move your\rinfantry in and seize the enemy HQ.\fThat's what you're best at, isn't it?\f
Ha...\fYou're as good as ever at breaking\reverything down and analyzing it.\fBut what are you doing, Sonja?\fWhy did you attack us?\f
I can't... I can't tell you, yet.\fYou'd better look over there.\f
Huh?\fThat's Andy!\fHow did you...?\f
I told him I had some new tools for him,\rand he followed me like a lost puppy.\f
(sigh)...\f
He should be waking up\ranytime now. Bye-bye.\f
The enemy units captured sixteen\rproperties, didn't they?\f
I've got to battle Sonja?\fI really don't want to.\f
If you mention that she gave you new\rtools again, I'm gonna thump you!\f
Yikes!\f
Do you have any idea what\rI had to go through? New tools! Hah!\fOh, and don't expect any sympathy\rfrom me if you lose!\f
This is the last test...\fShow me what you do, Andy!\f
Really?\fI wonder why Sami always gets so\rmad when she hears Sonja's name.\f
Yeah, I thought so.\fIn that case, who knows what'll\rhappen if I lose.\f
All right, Sonja! Now I\rwant some answers!\fWhy have you been attacking us?\f
All in due time, Sami.\rBut first, Andy.\f
What?\f
You don't have any weak points.\f
Well, of course not!\f
But you don't have any\rspecial strengths, either.\f
Huh?\f
Hey! Don't ignore me!\f
Sami.\f
Yeah?\f
How do you...?\f
That's not your concern.\fSee you again, Sami.\f
Where you unload your troops is\rkey to this mission.\fWhy don't you try unloading them\rsomewhere else next time?\fThe results may be more\rto your liking.\fGood luck! Don't give up!\f
Is that you, Nell?\rWhat is it?\f
We have an emergency!\fThe Coral Fortress is being stormed\rby Drake of Green Earth!\fWe've never had trouble with him\rbefore, so we didn't see them coming!\f
There are a bunch of bad guys here!\f

This point is of vital importance\rto Orange Star.\fIf the enemy seizes a lot of properties\rhere, we'll lose control of the area.\fYou have to beat them to it and\rsecure as many cities as possible.\fIncluding your bases and HQ, you\rmust secure twelve properties to win.\f
Secure as many properties\ras possible? OK, I got it!\f
I've got it covered!\f
Um...\f
Now's the time.\fI need to know if Orange Star was\rbehind these blackhearted acts.\fAnchors, away!\f
By the way, what kind\rof CO is Drake?\f
I've heard that he's virtually\runstoppable in naval combat.\fHis armada is supposed to be\ra real powerhouse.\f
There you go again, Sami!\rYou're a warehouse of intel.\f
But I could swear there was\rsomething else... Something big...\f
A job well done!\fYou've beaten me.\f
So, you're Drake?\f
That'd be me.\fI wanted to find some answers here,\rbut all I've netted are more questions.\fI'll be seeing you again, lad.\f
You were so close...\f

Drake's CO Power is really\rdangerous, isn't it?\fBut don't forget Andy's CO Power.\fIf you use it after Drake uses his,\ryou'll be fine!\fAndy's Power restores HP!\fGood luck! Keep your spirits up!\f
What's wrong?\f

CO Drake has hit us again!\fWe need you to come in and\rprotect this missile unit.\fIt's vital to Orange Star's\rstrategic success.\fWatch out for the enemy battleship to\rthe south; it's moving in to attack.\f
I understand!\fI just have to protect this\rmissile unit, right?\f
Nell!\rBoy, am I glad to see you!\f
You really stuck it out, didn't you!\f
CO Drake! If you want to continue\rthis, you'll have to face me!\f
Well, I'll be keelhauled! Nell and her\rtroops have surfaced!\fWe're outnumbered, we are!\fTime to pull anchor!\f

The area around the\rHQ is dangerous.\fSo, you have to get that missile\runit out of there!\fI would suggest using the landers to\rmove the unit to the north.\fTry using the reefs to hide in\rwhile you're on the move.\fThe enemy will have a hard time\rfinding you there.\fUse your recon and sub units to\rhelp find safe passage as well.\fAbove all, use caution.\rGood luck!\f
This'll be the third time\rI've faced Eagle.\fIt's about time to wrap\rhim up for good.\f
I'm gonna get him and make him tell me\rwhy he's been chasing me!\f
I must be dreaming!\fAndy! Are you getting serious on us?\f
Are you feeling OK, pal?\fYou comin' down with something?\f
Gimme a break, guys! I don't think you\runderstand what it means to be me.\f
Despite Drake's conviction, I\rfind it hard to credit his hypothesis.\fAndy! I'm coming for you!\f
C'mon, tell me! Why have\ryou been chasing me?\f
Don't play the fool with me, whelp!\fDo you expect me to forget what\ryou did to Green Earth?\f
Huh?\f
The look on your face during the\rassault... I'll never forget! Never!\f
No! You're wrong!\rIt wasn't me!\f
What do you take me for, boy?\fI saw your face!\f
I'm telling you, it wasn't me!\fWhy would I be out attacking\rother countries? Why?\f

Hmm...\fVery well. I'll take you at your\rword...for the moment.\fThere are Drake's thoughts to\rconsider, as well.\fBut don't believe for a moment\rthat I trust you.\fIf I find out you're lying to me,\ryou'll curse the day you were born!\f
What is it this time, Nell?\f
We've been able to outsmart\rCO Drake!\fOne of his landers is carrying vital\rcargo, and it's hiding in this area.\fIt's up to you to flush it out\rand destroy it!\f
Got it!\fI just need to find the lander\rand sink it, right?\f
That's it!\fI think it's safe to assume that\rDrake's hiding in the reefs somewhere.\fGo find him!\f
Barnacles!\fI was so worried about Eagle that\rI got trapped...\fAhh, I'll think of something.\f
Arrgh, you got me!\fI didn't think you'd find me here,\rand I let my guard down.\f
Commander Drake, would you please\rtell us why you've been attacking us?\f
Haven't you sensed him?\fThe person behind all of\rthis fighting?\fSonja and Grit have been trying\rto lure him out of hiding.\f
The person behind all this?\f

We've been trying to keep Sonja's\rmovements a secret.\fSo, we staged these battles to\rdraw his attention away from her.\fBut I think we're finished now.\fIt seems Sonja's found something.\fI'll be joining her as\rsoon as I'm able, but...\fI've got things to take care\rof in Green Earth.\fThis is a difficult thing for me\rto ask...\f
You don't have to!\fWe'll help in any way we can!\f
Blast!\fRight after Yellow Comet, it's on\rto Green Earth!\fWe're just trying to pass by. Why\rdoes everyone keep attacking us?\fI'd never heard there was any\rbad blood between our countries.\f
I'm as puzzled as you are.\fRegardless, we're facing CO Drake...\rThis is going to be rough.\f
What do you know about him?\f
I've heard that he's virtually\runstoppable in naval combat.\fHis armada is supposed to be\ra real powerhouse.\f
Oh, man! Why does Max get all\rthe fun combat?\f
Now's the time.\fI need to know if Orange Star was\rbehind that blackhearted act.\fAnchors, away!\f
A job well done!\fYou've beaten me.\f
You're a Green Earth CO?\f
That I am.\fI wanted to find some answers here,\rbut all I've netted are more questions.\fI'll be seeing you again, lad.\f
You were so close...\f

Drake's CO Power is really\rdangerous, isn't it?\fYou really should take out Drake's\rmain units before he uses his Power.\fDo you think you should give\rAndy a shot next time?\fGood luck! Keep your spirits up!\f
A mission for me? You must\rneed some serious smashin' done.\fWell, if that's the case, you\rknow I'm ready to go!\f
It's not that simple, Max.\rThere's a catch.\fThe main body of the Green Earth\rArmy is closing in on this position.\f
What? The entire army...?\f
That's right! So, we need to eliminate\rthe troops here ASAP, or else!\fLet's see... How much time...?\rFifteen days! That's all you've got.\f
Fifteen? That's a tall order.\rMan, I hate time limits!\f

Aarrgh! They're here already.\fA bit later and I could've greeted 'em\rwith the whole Green Earth Army.\fBut if I can keep 'em swimmin' in\rcircles for a while, I'll still win.\fPrepare to be boarded, ye\rscurvy dogs!\f
Curses! I've been defeated.\fTime to hoist sail and flee!\f

Time limit or no, rushing about\rwilly-nilly is not going to defeat Drake.\fUse units with large vision ranges to\rgather intel and scout out your path.\fTry the same techniques you used in\rother areas that had Fog of War.\fKeep fighting! Good luck!\f
Despite Drake's conviction, I\rfind it hard to credit his hypothesis.\fAndy! I'm coming for you!\f
Now, I want some answers!\rWhy're you hounding Andy?\f
You demand an answer? Very well.\rHere's your answer, Max.\fYour compatriot, Andy, viciously\rattacked my homeland.\f
Huh?\f
The look on his face during the\rassault... I'll never forget! Never!\f
Hey! Hold up a minute, Eagle.\fThere's no way Andy would do\rsomething like that.\fC'mon! He couldn't have planned all\rthat out. He's just a kid!\f
Um... Excuse me?\f
What I mean is, he does things\rfor a reason.\fAnd there's no reason for him to\rattack Green Earth. He didn't do it!\f

Hmm...\fVery well. I'll take you at your\rword...for the moment.\fBut don't believe for a moment\rthat I trust any of you.\fAndy, if I find that you're lying to me,\ryou'll curse the day you were born!\f
Drake means boats!\fJust watching is fun!\f
I bet Drake has some reason for\rchallenging us, just like Eagle.\f
If he's trying to find something out,\rI wish he'd just ask.\fBut it's never that easy, is it?\f
Another mission that revolves around\rlanders. Drake and his darn boats!\fIt's safe to say that he's not going to\rgo out of his way to make this easy.\fBut again, I think he has his reasons.\f
Yeah, you're probably right.\fWell, here I go!\f
I think they're ignoring me...\f
Time to make a big splash and\rgive Eagle some cover.\f
Same old shanty!\fI just can't beat you guys.\f
Commander Drake, would you please\rtell us why you've been attacking us?\f
Haven't you sensed him?\fThe person behind all of\rthis fighting?\fSonja and Grit have been trying\rto lure him out of hiding.\f
The person behind all this?\f
